# Danqing · 丹青 ### New color for discovery, faithful to every datum #### 赋科研以丹青，守数据之本真

简体中文文档 · Why Danqing · Quickstart & Cloud · Manuscript Match & 3,434 Palettes · Plugin & MCP · Citation

[![Live Studio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Live_Studio-danqing.onrender.com-C84B31?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://danqing.onrender.com) [![CI Status](https://github.com/owehann/danqing/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/owehann/danqing/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Deploy to Render](https://img.shields.io/badge/Deploy_to_Render-Free_%240_Blueprint-0D9488?style=flat-square&logo=render)](https://render.com/deploy?repo=https://github.com/owehann/danqing) [![Palettes: 3,434 Verified](https://img.shields.io/badge/Palettes-3%2C434_Primary--Source_Verified-C84B31?style=flat-square)](#-manuscript-match--the-3434-palettes) [![Plugin + MCP](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity_%2B_MCP-danqing__mcp-0F766E?style=flat-square)](#-agent-plugin--mcp-server) [![License: Apache-2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache_2.0-0284C7?style=flat-square)](./LICENSE)

## ✨ Why Danqing Scientists and students shouldn't lose hours tweaking hex codes, re-running plotting scripts twenty times, and staring at harsh or muddy colors just to make manuscript figures comfortable to read. **Danqing (丹青)** lets every scholar recolor finished vector figures — PDFs and SVGs exported from **R (`ggplot2`)**, **Python (`matplotlib` / `seaborn` / `scanpy`)**, **GraphPad Prism**, or **Adobe Illustrator** — in seconds, free and open-source, without altering a single coordinate, text glyph, or raw experimental image pixel.

📖 1. One-Click Manuscript Match

Pick a scholarly tone (CNS Clean, Clinical, Omics Atlas, Mineral & Museum) or type your target journal and field (optional Gemini 2.5 Flash + built-in perceptual comfort ranker) to match the whole paper's figure set without trial-and-error.

🎯 2. Lossless Vector Engine & Gate G0 Shield

Parses PDF content streams and SVG stylesheets under strict preview == export parity while physically locking Western blot lanes, H&E sections, immunofluorescence, and EM micrographs (verified bit-identical on export).

🎨 3. 3,434 Verified Palettes & Paired Ramps

Spans Accessible (Okabe–Ito, Petroff IEEE VIS, Paul Tol), Journal & Scientific (NPG/NEJM/Lancet, CNS Iso-Chroma, pypalettes), World Museums (MetBrewer, MoMAColors, nice-color-palettes), CC0 Eastern Artifacts & Sanzo Wada, and Crameri v8.0 / cmocean continuous maps — every palette paired with homologous 7-stop sequential & diverging ramps.

🤖 4. Antigravity Plugin, MCP & Zero-Retention Privacy

Ships with a native MCP server (danqing_mcp) and plugin.json for Google Antigravity, Claude Code, and Cursor, plus 100% RAM-only multi-visitor isolation and ready-to-paste ggplot2 & matplotlib export snippets.


--- ## 🚀 Quickstart & Zero-Cost Deployment ### Option A · Use Online Immediately (Free Forever) Open **[https://danqing.onrender.com](https://danqing.onrender.com)** in any desktop browser (`≥ 600 px`). ### Option B · Local Studio (3 Commands) ```bash pip install -e ".[dev]" (cd web/frontend && pnpm install && pnpm build) ./scripts/start_studio.sh ``` Open `http://127.0.0.1:8765`. ### Option C · Instant Share Link or Self-Hosted \$0 Cloud ```bash ./scripts/share_public.sh # Public HTTPS link via Cloudflare Quick Tunnel ($0) ./scripts/share_public.sh --lan # Lab / campus Wi-Fi LAN mode ($0) ``` [![Deploy to Render](https://render.com/images/deploy-to-render-button.svg)](https://render.com/deploy?repo=https://github.com/owehann/danqing) --- ## 🎨 Manuscript Match & The 3,434 Palettes Click **Manuscript Match (`论文配色定调`)** in the studio sidebar to select a journal aesthetic (`CNS Clean`, `Clinical`, `Omics Atlas`, `Mineral & Museum`) or describe your manuscript (with optional session-only Google AI Studio Gemini key support and zero-cost perceptual fallback). Every discrete palette also exposes homologous 7-stop `paired_sequential_stops` and `paired_diverging_stops` so discrete panels and heatmaps stay visually unified. | Collection | Count | Representative Palettes & Provenance | | :--- | :---: | :--- | | **Accessible** | `16` | Okabe–Ito, Petroff 6/8/10 (*Matplotlib 3.10 / IEEE VIS*), IBM Safe, Paul Tol (*Bright, Vibrant, Muted, High-Contrast*), CARTO Safe | | **Journal & Data-Vis** | `728` | 22 curated CNS Iso-Chroma series (*Nature Immunology*, *Cell Spatial Atlas*, *Science Translational*, *Cancer Discovery*, *Nature Medicine*), NPG/AAAS/NEJM/Lancet/JAMA/JCO (`*-inspired`), LocusZoom GWAS, Observable 10, Seaborn, Scanpy 10 & academic visualization schemes | | **Museum, Art & Design** | `2,094` | Metropolitan Museum of Art (`MetBrewer`, CC0), MoMA (`MoMAColors`, MIT), `PNWColors`, `NatParksPalettes`, Ghibli/cinema & `nice-color-palettes` (MIT) | | **Eastern & Sanzo Wada** | `252` | 24 deterministic CC0 Cleveland Museum of Art mineral artifact suites (Ru/Jun/Longquan celadons, Zhao Mengfu landscape, Hokusai Red Fuji) + 228 Sanzo Wada (1933) *Dictionary of Color Combinations* (MIT) | | **Many Colors (Single-Cell)** | `13` | Polychrome 36, Green-Armytage 25, Scanpy 20, Zeileis 28 & Ultra-Cluster 64, Kelly 22, Glasbey + dynamic hull expansion (`K > N`) | | **Continuous & Diverging** | `325` | 6 CNS white-paper ramps (`cns_ramp_*`, `cns_div_*`), Crameri *Scientific colour maps* v8.0 (`batlow`, `lipari`, `navia`, `vik`, `roma`, `bam`), `cmocean`, Viridis/Cividis, ColorBrewer 2.0, zero-midpoint lock | | **Domain Conventions** | `6` | COSMIC SBS-6 mutational signatures, Manhattan alternating chromosomes, Volcano `Up/Down/NS`, Cell Cycle `G1/S/G2M`, CNV `Gain/Loss/Neutral`, `A/C/G/T` bases | --- ## 🤖 Agent Plugin & MCP Server Danqing is packaged as a ready-to-use **Google Antigravity Plugin** ([`plugin.json`](./plugin.json) + [`mcp_config.json`](./mcp_config.json) + [`skills/danqing/SKILL.md`](./skills/danqing/SKILL.md)) and standard **MCP stdio server** (`danqing-mcp` / `python -m danqing.mcp_server`) exposing four tools: - `danqing_inspect_figure` — Inspect discrete groups, panels, continuous scales, protected raw images, and deuteranopia diagnostics. - `danqing_match_manuscript_palettes` — Recommend the 3 most comfortable palettes for a figure or manuscript brief. - `danqing_recolor_figure` — Losslessly recolor a `.pdf` or `.svg` with byte-level geometry/image verification plus `.palette.R` & `.palette.py` code output. - `danqing_list_palettes` — Search and filter the 3,434 verified palettes (including homologous paired gradient stops). --- ## 📝 Citation & Attribution Created and maintained by **Xinyin Han** ([@owehann](https://github.com/owehann)). If Danqing saves you time preparing figures or manuscripts, please cite the software (GitHub's **Cite this repository** button reads [`CITATION.cff`](./CITATION.cff) automatically): ```bibtex @software{han2026danqing, author = {Han, Xinyin}, title = {{Danqing: Lossless Scientific Figure \& Manuscript Recoloring Studio}}, year = {2026}, version = {0.3.0}, url = {https://github.com/owehann/danqing}, license = {Apache-2.0} } ``` - **Code & Brand Assets**: [Apache License 2.0](./LICENSE) — Copyright © 2026 Xinyin Han (`0` GPL/AGPL runtime dependencies). - **Palette Provenance & Public Benchmark Datasets**: Documented in [`NOTICE`](./NOTICE) and [`core/danqing/palettes/VERIFICATION.md`](./core/danqing/palettes/VERIFICATION.md).

# 丹青 · Danqing ### 赋科研以丹青，守数据之本真 #### New color for discovery, faithful to every datum

English Documentation · 为什么做丹青 · 快速使用与云部署 · 论文配色定调与色库 · Agent 插件与 MCP · 软件署名

[![Live Studio](https://img.shields.io/badge/在线工作台-danqing.onrender.com-C84B31?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://danqing.onrender.com) [![CI Status](https://github.com/owehann/danqing/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/owehann/danqing/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Deploy to Render](https://img.shields.io/badge/Render_免费云部署-%240_免绑卡蓝图-0D9488?style=flat-square&logo=render)](https://render.com/deploy?repo=https://github.com/owehann/danqing) [![Palettes: 3,434 Verified](https://img.shields.io/badge/权威调色板-3%2C434_套溯源核验-C84B31?style=flat-square)](#-论文配色定调与-3434-套核验色库) [![Plugin + MCP](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity_%2B_MCP-danqing__mcp-0F766E?style=flat-square)](#-agent-插件与-mcp-服务) [![License: Apache-2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache_2.0-0284C7?style=flat-square)](./LICENSE)

## ✨ 为什么做丹青 科研人与学生不该把宝贵的时间和心流浪费在反复凑十六进制色号、改完脚本重跑二十遍、盯着刺眼或发灰的配色越看越烦躁的内耗里。 **丹青（Danqing）** 免费开源地服务每一位研究者——不动分毫原始数据坐标、字体排版与实验像素，为 **R (`ggplot2`)**、**Python (`matplotlib` / `seaborn` / `scanpy`)**、**GraphPad Prism** 与 **Adobe Illustrator** 导出的 PDF 或 SVG 矢量图一键换上舒适、和谐、经得起审稿检验的科学配色。

📖 1.「论文配色定调」一键匹配

内置顶刊清朗、临床医学、高维组学、温润博物四大刊风预设及期刊/课题自由匹配（支持接入免费 Gemini 2.5 Flash 推理与内置视觉舒适度排序引擎），无需在数百套色板里盲目试错，整篇论文多图瞬间统一格调。

🎯 2. 无损矢量引擎与原始证据护盾

深度解析 PDF 内容流与 SVG 样式表（严格满足 预览 == 导出），自动识别并物理锁定图表内嵌的 Western blot 条带、H&E 病理切片、免疫荧光与电镜原图，导出前后逐字节一致。

🎨 3. 7 大馆藏级核验色库（3,434 套 + 同源渐变）

囊括色盲无障碍标准（Okabe–Ito、Petroff、Paul Tol）、期刊与科研可视化（NPG/NEJM/Lancet、CNS 等彩度十二色、pypalettes）、世界艺术馆藏（大都会 MetBrewer、MoMA、精选设计色卡）、CC0 东方器物与和田三造《配色总鉴》及 Crameri v8.0 / cmocean 连续色阶，每套离散色卡均自带 7 阶同源连续与发散渐变。

🤖 4. 原生 Agent 插件、MCP 与零留存隐私

原生附带 Google Antigravity 插件清单与 MCP 服务（danqing_mcp），一句话即可在 AI 助手中自动完成无损换色与 R/Python 代码生成；网页端采用 100% 纯内存零落盘 + 多访客密码学隔离。


--- ## 🚀 快速使用与零成本部署 ### 方式一：打开网页直接使用（永久免费） 在桌面浏览器（宽度 `≥ 600 px`）直接访问：**[https://danqing.onrender.com](https://danqing.onrender.com)** ### 方式二：本地工作台启动（3 条命令） ```bash pip install -e ".[dev]" (cd web/frontend && pnpm install && pnpm build) ./scripts/start_studio.sh ``` 浏览器打开 `http://127.0.0.1:8765`。 ### 方式三：免账号临时分享或自建 \$0 云实例 ```bash ./scripts/share_public.sh # 生成 https://*.trycloudflare.com 公网加密链接 ($0) ./scripts/share_public.sh --lan # 同一实验室 / 校园 Wi-Fi 局域网高速模式 ($0) ``` [![Deploy to Render](https://render.com/images/deploy-to-render-button.svg)](https://render.com/deploy?repo=https://github.com/owehann/danqing) --- ## 🎨 论文配色定调与 3,434 套核验色库 在右侧调色板栏顶部点击 **「论文配色定调」**，即可按投稿刊风（`顶刊清朗` / `临床医学` / `高维组学` / `温润博物`）或自由输入课题方向，自动根据当前图表的组别数量与连续热图结构筛出最舒适耐看的 3 套推荐方案。全库每套色板均附带 7 阶同源连续与发散色阶（`paired_sequential_stops` / `paired_diverging_stops`），让多栏离散图与热图自然呼应。 | 分类 | 数量 | 代表配色与学术/馆藏溯源 | | :--- | :---: | :--- | | **色盲友好（Accessible）** | `16` | Okabe–Ito、Petroff 6/8/10（*IEEE VIS / Matplotlib 3.10*）、IBM Safe、Paul Tol 全系列、CARTO Safe | | **期刊与现代数据科学（Journal）** | `728` | 22 套纯正 CNS 等彩度低疲劳系列（*Nature Immunology*、*Cell Spatial Atlas*、*Science Translational*、*Cancer Discovery*、*Nature Medicine*）、NPG/AAAS/NEJM/Lancet/JAMA/JCO（`*-inspired`）、LocusZoom、Observable 10、Scanpy 10 与统计可视化色库 | | **世界馆藏与自然设计（Museum）** | `2,094` | 大都会博物馆 `MetBrewer`（CC0）、现代艺术博物馆 `MoMAColors`（MIT）、`PNWColors`、`NatParksPalettes`、`nice-color-palettes` 及精选艺术/设计色卡（MIT） | | **东方器物与和田三造（Eastern）** | `252` | 克利夫兰艺术博物馆 48 幅 CC0 藏品确定性提取 24 套矿物色（汝钧青瓷、赵孟頫青绿山水、赤富士等）+ 和田三造 1933《配色总鉴》228 套经典组合（MIT） | | **单细胞/空间多簇（Many Colors）** | `13` | Polychrome 36、Green-Armytage 25、Scanpy 20、Zeileis 28 / Ultra-Cluster 64、Kelly 22、Glasbey + 动态多簇扩展 | | **连续与发散色阶（Continuous）** | `325` | 6 套 CNS 白底专用连续/双向色阶（`cns_ramp_*`、`cns_div_*`）、Crameri v8.0 科学色阶（`batlow`、`lipari`、`navia`、`vik`、`roma`）、`cmocean`、Viridis/Cividis、ColorBrewer 2.0，发散色阶自动锁定零点 | | **学科常规约定（Conventions）** | `6` | COSMIC SBS-6 突变谱、曼哈顿图染色体双色、火山图 `Up/Down/NS`、细胞周期 `G1/S/G2M`、拷贝数 `Gain/Loss/Neutral`、四碱基 `A/C/G/T` | --- ## 🤖 Agent 插件与 MCP 服务 本仓库内置标准 **Google Antigravity 插件清单**（[`plugin.json`](./plugin.json) + [`mcp_config.json`](./mcp_config.json) + [`skills/danqing/SKILL.md`](./skills/danqing/SKILL.md)）与零额外依赖的 **MCP 标准服务端**（`danqing-mcp` / `python -m danqing.mcp_server`），提供 4 个确定性工具： - `danqing_inspect_figure` — 解析 PDF/SVG 分栏、离散组别、连续色阶、受保护实验原图与色盲安全指标； - `danqing_match_manuscript_palettes` — 根据论文期刊与组数一键推荐 3 套最舒适和谐的科研色板； - `danqing_recolor_figure` — 字节级无损换色导出，并同步写出 `.palette.R`（`ggplot2`）与 `.palette.py`（`matplotlib`）代码； - `danqing_list_palettes` — 按分类、颜色数或无障碍属性检索全部 3,434 套核验色库（含同源连续/发散渐变）。 --- ## 📝 软件署名与引用 本项目由 **Xinyin Han**（[@owehann](https://github.com/owehann)）设计开发并开源维护。若丹青为你节省了论文改图与配色的时间，欢迎在致谢或软件引用中署名（GitHub 右侧栏 **Cite this repository** 按钮可直接读取 [`CITATION.cff`](./CITATION.cff)）： ```bibtex @software{han2026danqing, author = {Han, Xinyin}, title = {{Danqing: Lossless Scientific Figure \& Manuscript Recoloring Studio}}, year = {2026}, version = {0.3.0}, url = {https://github.com/owehann/danqing}, license = {Apache-2.0} } ``` - **核心代码与视觉资产**：[Apache License 2.0](./LICENSE) — Copyright © 2026 Xinyin Han（零 GPL/AGPL 运行时依赖）。 - **调色板文献与公开数据集溯源**：详见 [`NOTICE`](./NOTICE) 与 [`core/danqing/palettes/VERIFICATION.md`](./core/danqing/palettes/VERIFICATION.md)。
